text: Changxin Technology Group shares closed at 49 yuan after pricing at 8.66 yuan in its STAR Market IPO, producing a market capitalization of about 3.3 trillion yuan. The company became the highest-valued China-listed firm. The IPO raised 57.92 billion yuan, and the firm reported a 7.67% global DRAM market share in 2025.

meta.note: Valuation ranking and market debut occur within the same atomic event.
